items.instructions: Choose the word that matches each definition.

items.prompt: to be present at an event, a class or a meeting

explanation.en: To attend is to be present at something. To assist means to help.
explanation.es: Attend equivale a asistir a un acto; assist significa ayudar, no asistir.

items.prompt: in the end, after a long time or a series of delays

explanation.en: Eventually means finally, after some time. It does not mean possibly.
explanation.es: Eventually significa finalmente, no eventualmente (que sería possibly).

items.prompt: showing good judgement; practical and reasonable

explanation.en: A sensible person makes good, practical choices. Sensitive is the word for easily hurt or upset.
explanation.es: Sensible en inglés es sensato; para sensible di sensitive.

items.prompt: feeling ashamed or awkward in front of other people

explanation.en: Embarrassed describes the awkward feeling you have after a social mistake.

items.prompt: a building or room where you can borrow books

explanation.en: A library lends books. A shop that sells books is a bookshop.
explanation.es: Library es biblioteca; librería se dice bookshop.

items.instructions: Complete each sentence with the best word.

items.prompt: She worked two jobs to ___ her younger brother while he was at university.

explanation.en: To support someone is to help them, especially with money. To put up with something is to bear it.
explanation.es: Support es apoyar o mantener a alguien; soportar se dice put up with o stand.

items.prompt: The fire ___ is at the end of the corridor, next to the lift.

explanation.en: An exit is a way out of a building. The word for a good result is success.
explanation.es: Exit es salida, no éxito (que es success).

items.prompt: The new café was an instant ___, with queues out of the door every day.

explanation.en: A success is a good result. An event that happens is an incident or an event.
explanation.es: Success es éxito, no suceso (que sería event o incident).

items.prompt: After weeks of disagreement, the two parties finally reached a ___ over the funding.

explanation.en: A compromise is an agreement in which each side gives something up. A commitment is a promise or duty.
explanation.es: Compromise es un acuerdo con cesiones; compromiso (obligación) es commitment.

items.prompt: I didn't ___ that I had the wrong file until I opened it in the meeting.

explanation.en: To realise is to become aware of a fact. To carry out a plan is to do it.
explanation.es: Realise es darse cuenta; realizar un proyecto se dice carry out.
